name: mast
description: Pager for Claude Code and for the apps it builds. Your phone buzzes until you acknowledge when Claude is blocked on you, finishes a long turn, or stops on an error; Claude can page you on request and wait for your OK. And when you ask Claude to alert you from an app it is building, it wires a push page (one HTTP POST, repeat-until-acked, dedupe, cron heartbeats) instead of defaulting to email.

channel_url.title: Mast channel URL
channel_url.description: The send URL of a channel from the Mast app (https://mast.tissue.dev/mk_…). Environment variable MAST_CHANNEL_URL and ~/.config/mast/channel work too.
